description: This file defines the DashboardScreen widget in a Flutter application. It displays an overview of attendance data, including summaries for today, quick actions, and a list of attendance records. It uses providers for state management and showcases UI components like cards, buttons, and chips.

classes.name: _SummaryCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a card with a title, subtitle, icon, and content region.

classes.name: _CounterPill
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a small pill with a label and count, stylized with a background color.

classes.name: _StatusChip
classes.description: A widget that displays a chip with a status label, colored based on the status value.

methods.name: _countStatus
methods.description: Counts the number of items in a list that match a specific status.

methods.name: _dateKey
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string key with 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
